items.title: Branford Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I told him when I heard Marcus Miller playing with Miles’s band, Marcus is an incredible bass guitarist, but he doesn’t know how to lock down a drummer that rushes, cause Al Foster is not a good funk drummer, so he would always rush when he played.

ctx.x: That’s why he brought up, “I need a bass player.” I said, “Darryl Jones.’ He said, “Why Darryl?” I said, “Because he plays the bass, not the bass guitar.” Then he said, “Ok, sure.” No he does. I told him when I heard Marcus Miller playing with Miles’s band, Marcus is an incredible bass guitarist, but he doesn’t know how to lock down a drummer that rushes, cause Al Foster is not a good funk drummer, so he would always rush when he played. But when Darryl joined the band Al couldn’t rush, cause Darryl locked him…
